data.one_liner: A scrollable, dismissable by swiping, zoomable gallery widget with dynamic overlays.
data.what_it_does: Provides a scrollable and zoomable image or widget gallery that can be dismissed by swiping. It supports custom item builders, dynamic overlays, hero animations, and vertical scrolling.
use_when: You need a zoomable and swipe-dismissible image viewer modal or screen.
You want to display a gallery of images or custom widgets with hero animations and dynamic overlays.
avoid_when: You need a simple inline grid view rather than a full gallery modal/viewer.
You require complex image caching and loading features out of the box without providing custom widgets.
strengths: Supports zoom, pan, and swipe-to-dismiss interactions.
Allows custom item builders and dynamic overlays.
Supports Hero animations for seamless transitions.
weaknesses: Lacks built-in advanced image caching and placeholder management compared to dedicated image packages.
Dependent on the developer supplying network image widgets or builders.

alternatives.name: photo_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick photo_view if you need specialized standalone zoomable and pannable image widgets.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick cached_network_image if your main requirement is loading and caching images from URLs rather than specifically a swipe gallery modal.
